reason: Mounting the cord posts establishes where the vibrating cord will go.
expectation: The posts and tension screw will attach to the base, ready for the cord.

alternatives.reason: Mounting the motor also seems necessary, but I chose to start with the cord supports.

effect: The cord posts are in place; the motor assembly is the only offered combination.
reaction: A straightforward start; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The motor needs its cradle to be mounted for the drive.
expectation: The motor will fit into the cradle, ready to attach to the base.

effect: The motor is secured and ready to mount on the base.
reaction: The assembly is straightforward so far.
reason: Attaching the motor to the base is the only offered combination and advances the drive.
expectation: The motor cradle will attach to the base alongside the cord posts.

effect: The motor is mounted on the wave frame, ready for the drive parts.
reason: The eccentric driver is the only offered combination and should help turn rotation into cord movement.
expectation: The driver will attach to the frame, though it may still need the belt to move.

effect: The off-centre swivel peg will disturb one end of the cord; the belt should connect it to the motor.
reaction: The circular peg motion makes the intended wiggle clearer.
reason: The belt is the only offered combination and should transmit the motor's rotation to the driver.
expectation: The belt will connect the motor and eccentric driver, though the cord and guard will still need fitting.

effect: The belt drive is in place, ready for the cord.
reason: The cord is the only offered combination and is needed to make the wave visible.
expectation: The cord will attach between the driver and the far post, though it may still need tensioning.

effect: The cord is attached but loose, so it needs tensioning.
reaction: The loose cord makes the spring's purpose clear.
reason: The tension spring is the only offered combination and should hold the cord taut.
expectation: The spring will tension the cord; the drive guard may still need fitting.

effect: The cord is tensioned, leaving the drive guard to fit.
reaction: The spring did what I expected.
reason: The guard is the only offered combination and should cover the moving drive.
expectation: The clear guard will fit over the drive, completing the guarded wave machine or making it ready for testing.

effect: The guarded drive is complete, but the motor cannot run until a controller arrives, so the cord's motion remains untested.
reaction: The clear guard is a satisfying safety detail, though I would have liked to see the machine run.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eccentric driver was most worthwhile: the explanation made clear how rotation would disturb the cord.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the motor was straightforward but not very engaging; it was also the only offered combination at that point.

surprise.text: The motor remains disconnected until a controller arrives, so completing this chapter does not demonstrate the wave.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though most steps offered only one combination, leaving little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue to see the cord actually move and learn what patterns the machine makes; the eccentric drive has made me curious.
